---
title: "Results: Dual-Target Multiplex Compatibility"
---

To enable simultaneous point-of-care detection of **Influenza A** and **Influenza B** in a single reaction tube, candidate assays designed for the Indonesian cohort were evaluated using the **Multiplex Compatibility Screening Engine** (`scripts/m11_multiplex_checker.py`).

The screening engine evaluates all pairwise heterodimerization thermodynamics ($\Delta G$), kinetic melting temperature alignment ($\Delta T_m$), and fluorophore channel separation across a 6-oligo reaction mixture ($\text{Fwd}_A, \text{Rev}_A, \text{Probe}_A, \text{Fwd}_B, \text{Rev}_B, \text{Probe}_B$).

---

## 1. Dual-Temperature Screening Regimes

To guarantee assay robustness, **100 candidate combinations** ($10 \times 10$ matrix of top Influenza A MP and Influenza B MP candidates) were evaluated across two temperature regimes:

1.  **Isothermal RT-RAA Mode ($39.0^\circ\text{C}$)**: Primary operational temperature for point-of-care recombinase-mediated amplification.
2.  **qPCR Comparative Benchmark ($55.0^\circ\text{C}$)**: Gold-standard laboratory thermal cycling benchmark.

---

## 2. Top Recommended Multiplex Assay Combinations

The table below highlights the top 5 multiplex combinations ranked by overall compatibility score ($0 - 100\%$), accounting for cross-dimer penalties and kinetic alignment:

| Rank | Candidate Pair | Compatibility Score | RAA ΔG (39°C) | qPCR ΔG (55°C) | ΔTm (°C) | Channel Separation | Status (39°C) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **`FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank6`** | **73.9%** | **-7.13 kcal/mol** | **-5.01 kcal/mol** | **0.29°C** | FAM / HEX | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **2** | **`FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank11`** | **73.8%** | **-7.13 kcal/mol** | **-5.01 kcal/mol** | **0.31°C** | FAM / HEX | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **3** | **`FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank5`** | **73.2%** | **-7.13 kcal/mol** | **-5.01 kcal/mol** | **0.45°C** | FAM / HEX | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **4** | **`FluA_Rank4_x_FluB_Rank6`** | **72.1%** | **-7.13 kcal/mol** | **-5.01 kcal/mol** | **0.74°C** | FAM / HEX | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
| **5** | **`FluA_Rank6_x_FluB_Rank6`** | **72.1%** | **-7.13 kcal/mol** | **-5.01 kcal/mol** | **0.74°C** | FAM / HEX | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |

### Key Biophysical Observations:
*   **Zero Veto Violations**: All top combinations exhibit a worst-case cross-dimer binding energy $\Delta G > -9.0\text{ kcal/mol}$, preventing spontaneous primer-dimer formation or competition during strand exchange.
*   **Kinetic Balance**: The rank 1 combination (`FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank6`) achieves an exceptionally tight $T_m$ delta of **$0.29^\circ\text{C}$** across all four primers, ensuring synchronized amplification rates.
*   **Fluorophore Independence**: Influenza A probe uses FAM ($\lambda_{\text{em}} = 520\text{ nm}$) and Influenza B probe uses HEX ($\lambda_{\text{em}} = 556\text{ nm}$), eliminating optical crosstalk.

---

## 3. Oligo Synthesis Specifications (Rank 1 Recommended Pair: `FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank6`)

To ensure full transparency and laboratory synthesis readiness, the complete sequence strings, lengths, melting temperatures ($T_m$), GC percentages, and fluorophore dye modifications for all 6 oligos in the primary recommended multiplex set are listed below:

### 🟩 Target A: Influenza A MP (FAM Channel)

| Oligo Name | Type | IUPAC Degenerate Sequence (5' $\rightarrow$ 3') | Length | Tm (°C) | GC (%) | Modification / Tag |

| **FluA_Rev** | Reverse Primer | `AGCAGTTAAACTATATARGAARCTGAARAGR` | 31 nt | 60.4°C | 25.8% | Unlabeled |
| **FluA_Probe** | Exo-Probe | `ACCGTGCCCAGTGAGCGAGGACTGCAGCGTAGACGCTTTRTCCARAATGCC` | 51 nt | 81.6°C | 56.9% | `5'-FAM` / `3'-BHQ1` / `Internal-THF` |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| **FluB_Probe** | Exo-Probe | `TYTTATCAGCTCTCCATTTCATGGCTTGGACAATAGGRCATTTRAATC` | 48 nt | 71.3°C | 35.4% | `5'-HEX` / `3'-BHQ1` / `Internal-THF` |

## 4. Oligo Cross-Dimer Interactions (Rank 1 Assay)

Below is the complete 9-pair inter-assay cross-dimer thermodynamic breakdown for the primary recommended multiplex set (`FluA_Rank7_x_FluB_Rank6`):

| Oligo Pair Combination | Cross-Dimer ΔG (39°C RT-RAA) | Cross-Dimer ΔG (55°C qPCR) | Risk Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Forward A vs. Forward B** | -4.14 kcal/mol | -2.05 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Forward A vs. Reverse B** | -7.13 kcal/mol | -5.01 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Forward A vs. Probe B** | -3.09 kcal/mol | -1.53 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Forward B** | -5.95 kcal/mol | -3.06 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Reverse B** | -4.37 kcal/mol | -2.27 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Reverse A vs. Probe B** | -5.69 kcal/mol | -3.49 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Forward B** | -4.77 kcal/mol | -2.83 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Negligible</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Reverse B** | -6.12 kcal/mol | -3.49 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |
| **Probe A vs. Probe B** | -6.90 kcal/mol | -4.22 kcal/mol | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">Low / Safe</span> |

## 5. Triplex Multiplex Compatibility Results (3-Virus Assay)

To enable single-reaction surveillance of all three targets (**Influenza A**, **Influenza B**, and **Measles**), the top candidates from each virus cohort were evaluated across a **9-oligo mixture** (6 primers + 3 probes).

| **4** | **`FluA_R9_FluB_R14_Measles_R5`** | **66.7%** | **-6.90 kcal/mol** | **1.88°C** | <span style="color: #10b981; font-weight: bold;">PASS</span> |
